user_review.comment: Is it nice? Sure. But as is often the case in Oz, this is a migrant worker dormitory pretending to be a hostel. Almost all of the guests are young Europeans on the Australian work visa program staying there for months. Socially, this means it sucks to stay there as a nomad/backpacker/traveler, because you’re the new kid who’s not staying long. ||Look, is the place nice? Sure. Decent rooms, nice lounge upstairs, good kitchen, cool outdoor lounge, and great little pool. Great location too, but it’s not a hostel full of interesting, curious adventurers. It’s a workers' dormitory. You even receive emails about job opportunities when you stay there. That's weird.||Side note: Because there are so few arrivals, there’s rarely staff present. If you show up after 5pm, there’s no way to check in, so they force you to do that obnoxious online check-in thing where you take photos of your passport, selfies of your face, endless forms to fill out. It sucks. Newsflash to management: Everyone hates that. Stop doing it. I don’t know when having a human to greet guests became optional, but it’s cold and rude to automate it.
Very musty. Never been to a room smelled this bad
